question: Tomorrow’s session uses the same project and embedding server. Should AM remember your choice, or ask again?
selected_option_description: No repeated prompts. Ask again if the server or permitted memory scope changes.

product_decision.scope: The same project, chosen embedding service destination and permitted memory-disclosure scope.
product_decision.reapproval: AM MUST ask again when the service destination or permitted memory scope changes, and MUST stop relying on the choice when the operator revokes it.
product_decision.ordinary_use: A new agent session, ordinary permitted memory update or lookup MUST NOT by itself require another approval.
product_decision.authority_boundary: This is embedding-service permission only. It MUST NOT authorize export into shared memory, sibling-project access or disclosure of previously unapproved content.

limits: This records the lifetime of a future explicit operator choice; it is not a new grant to send existing project content now.
The trusted approval channel, identity verification and exact private receipt design remain execution-contract work.
This does not approve a model, resource or spending ceiling, setup defaults, production licensing, calibration, runtime qualification or release.
Remembering a choice does not authorize retention/use terms outside its approved disclosure scope or bypass current source, privacy, credential, resource or endpoint checks.
